name: ChapterPage - Forming Chapter
description: A forming (WhatsApp-only) chapter page, the state DC and Seattle are in: the hero with the Online group kicker, then the three-button band (WhatsApp, newsletter, volunteer or co-lead), and nothing else. The fixture deliberately PASSES a lead, a callout and showGallery true; none of them may render, because a forming page shows no leads, callouts, write-up, events, gallery, sign-up band, global-community band or Connect with us. Compare with ChapterPage - Full Chapter for the active shape, which keeps every section.
